entities.name: The Trapper (Island)
entities.bio: He may look intimidating with his machete and spiked traps, but take him on a walk along the tropical beach and he might just show you his soft, artistic side.
entities.tagline: Muscles, bear traps, and secretly loves carving romantic driftwood.
entities.quote: "If you step into my snare, I won’t let you go easily."

entities.turn_on: Sun-kissed skin and deep philosophical conversations under the stars
entities.dealbreaker: People who touch his private trap stash
red_flags: Steps on his own traps when flustered
